meta.title: Pandoc 3.10 LaTeX reader — recognized constructs index
meta.scope: LaTeX reader recognition only. Math is boundary-only; in-math commands belong to texmath (out of scope).

columns.name: dispatch key / construct name
columns.latex_form: how it is written in LaTeX
columns.kind: inline_command | block_command | environment | table_environment | math_environment | math_delimiter | table_command | inline_command_family | classifier
columns.source_map: the dispatch map (or set) that holds it

raw_tex_values.unchanged: recognized; transforms identically with or without +raw_tex
raw_tex_values.raw_inline_if_on: rawInlineOr: becomes RawInline(latex) when +raw_tex, else handled
raw_tex_values.raw_block_if_on: rawBlockOr: becomes RawBlock(latex) when +raw_tex, else handled
raw_tex_values.raw_if_on_else_drop: no handler: raw passthrough when +raw_tex, else DROPPED

fallbacks_for_UNrecognized.unknown_environment: Div .name with parsed body (default) / one RawBlock(latex) with +raw_tex; DEFINING the environment removes the Div

meta.notes: Duplicate names across source_maps are intentional (e.g. textcolor is both inline and block; textnormal is in rest and biblatexInlineCommands). The text<lang> family is compacted to one row (see reference doc 5.16).

constructs.name: enumerate
constructs.notes: numbering style from opt; enumitem keys dropped
LineBreak only OUTSIDE a table cell (row break inside)
